description.en: Two-layer long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: a global markdown file plus per-project files, injected as a prompt section on every assembly, with a Settings panel to toggle each layer and read its content.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的两层长期记忆：一个全局 markdown 文件加按项目分级的文件，每次提示词组装时作为提示词段注入，并在设置面板里为每层提供开关与正文查看。
